'''Biblack''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Biblack was a retired [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in his late fifties, and owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair business [[Biblack's Overhaul]] at the [[Lola Curich Starport]]. He employed three assistants and multiple [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. He had a good reputation and was known to speak his mind.
